verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes run arbitrary commands in containers built from custom images with any dependency, so you can run multiple language runtimes by choosing an image and calling exec. The docs show running commands, a subprocess-style Sandbox API, and an agent example that executes generated Python. However, results come back as process-style command output and logs, with no evidenced code-interpreter layer that returns structured or rich outputs such as charts, display data or typed results. The JS/Go SDKs are client SDKs for controlling sandboxes, not evidence of in-sandbox runtimes. Missing for 10: explicit first-class multi-language runtime support (e.g. JavaScript kernels), rich/structured result objects beyond stdout/stderr, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-language execution.
